No original asset bytes were retrieved under this contract.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: CROPGRIDSv1.08 maps modelled 2020 harvested area (harvarea, hectares) and physical crop area (croparea, hectares) of 173 crops on a WGS84 0.05-degree global grid, alongside source/quality flags. Repeated harvests can yield harvarea greater than croparea. The gridded estimates fuse earlier MRF, additional gridded sources, subnational reports and FAOSTAT 2020: they are not independent FAOSTAT total validation, field boundaries, insured area, TIV or agricultural CAT losses. The original Figshare v9 six-file release must not be conflated with the later FAO/CGIAR COG catalogue of 171 distinct file identities; inspect original per-crop NetCDF and the source quality flags before scientific use.
